title: The Archer Packs a Picnic
skyStory: The moon has started to wane, ninety-two percent and gently shrinking, and has trotted into Sagittarius, the archer, who would very much like to go on an adventure, preferably with snacks. Sagittarius is packing a picnic basket with no clear destination. Saturn suggests a map. Mars suggests just going. The archer throws the map in the basket and leaves.

reading: Fire moon in a fire sign, and the Tiger wants to roam. Find twenty minutes today to go somewhere you have never been, even if it is just the end of a road you always drive past.

Bring something to eat, because Sagittarius believes every expedition deserves a snack. Sit somewhere new and look around like an explorer who just discovered a continent. Around 4 pm, notice three things you have never seen before within a short walk of your usual path. The [[Eight of Wands]] fly overhead, eight arrows all heading the same direction, fast and true. Follow where they point.
joel.mission: Take a turn down a road or path you have never explored, and stop for a snack at the end.
joel.omen: An arrow drawn in chalk or painted on a sign. It means follow your curiosity today, it knows the way.

reading: The archer moon wants you to share a meal with someone today, and to tell a story while you do. Sagittarius is the storyteller's moon, wandering and generous and a little bit loud.

Pick a favourite person, a favourite table, and an excuse. Bring your best story, the one with a twist at the end. Your hands will do the rest. Around 7 pm, the conversation will turn to dreams and places you want to see. Name one out loud. The [[Three of Cups]] is raising a glass somewhere nearby, celebrating friendship and the simple joy of a shared table.
nancy.mission: Invite someone to share a meal or snack, and tell them the best story you know.
nancy.omen: Someone laughing loudly at the next table. It means your joy is contagious today, so spread it.

together.text: Each eat one thing today you have never tasted before, no matter how small, and describe it to the other using only three adjectives. The archer moon will try to guess what it was. It will guess wrong and be delighted.

game.intro: The Archer packed a picnic. Make the sound of something at a picnic and let your friend guess it.
game.prompt: A picnic sound: a cooler lid, a fly that won't leave, a can popping open, a blanket in the wind.
